reason: £240 is a lot on my income when I can scroll Marketplace most nights and find used sets for £100-150 and haggle. The fit guarantee and viewing first are nice, but I'd still go for the cheaper ones.
objection: Too dear compared with used sets on Marketplace and eBay, and they're a new seller with no reviews, so I'd be taking a chance with £240 I can't really spare.
would_change_my_mind: A price nearer £150 for the set, or a few real reviews from local buyers.
